page: Microsoft Azure D372ds_v7 is a high-capacity general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 family. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance is powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel processors providing 372 dedicated vCPUs. Memory allocation stands at 1488.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

A key hardware element of the D372ds_v7 is its bundled storage subsystem, featuring 22677 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The system contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, directing its architectural footprint entirely toward high-density CPU and fast local disk throughput.

Resource allocation on this scale optimizes compute density for workloads that demand substantial parallel processing, large in-memory working sets, and high-throughput temporary storage. The instance profile is suited for massive relational and non-relational database deployments, extensive ETL and batch processing jobs, enterprise CI/CD orchestration, and high-concurrency web serving environments requiring extensive local NVMe caching.
